gaps.title: Half-pixel hairlines
gaps.note: Linear 0.5px edges on controls, menus, cards and dialogs (drawn mostly as a `::after` box-shadow ring). They are one device pixel, not half a CSS pixel: `--sx-1ele6il` and `--editor-hairline` compute 0.5px at DPR 2 and 1px at DPR 1, where the colors step up to hold the same weight (control edges #e5e5e5 / #38383a in the 2026-10-25 census at DPR 1)
gaps.standin: 1px edges, lightened to the card edge (controlEdge soft)

gaps.title: Small drop under primary buttons
gaps.note: Linear's primary pill carries `lch(0 0 0 / 0.02) 0 3px 6px -2px, lch(0 0 0 / 0.04) 0 1px 1px` in light and `lch(0 0 0 / 0.3) 0 0.5px 1px 1px` in dark; the secondary's drop sits on its `::after` ring, which the probe reads as the edge
gaps.standin: a flat primary: no button style keeps Flat's face and adds only a drop

gaps.title: Warning washes on their own hue in both modes
gaps.note: Linear's yellow callouts and pills sit on cream #fcf1d2 (oklch hue 91) in light and olive-brown #3a3421 (hue 93) in dark. From the same yellow seed (#f0bf00) the engine's warning wash drifts to olive #f1f1db (hue 107) in light and orange-brown #361c05 (hue 59) in dark (2026-10-27 visual review: Custom domain, Approval prompt, the Logs banner, Dashboard and Invoice pending pills)
gaps.standin: the engine's warning scale from Linear's yellow seed
